title: Pi Coding Agent Plugins: Local RAG & Persistent Terminal
date_basis: canonical public page exposed relative 4mo only; exact date was not asserted
summary: 作者介绍两个 Pi 插件：Local BM25 RAG 为本地文件建立索引并按关键词检索；Persistent Terminal 在 Pi 内保留 PTY、当前目录、virtualenv 与环境变量，区别于内置 bash 每次启动新的 subshell。
why_useful: 提供本地检索与跨命令终端状态持久化的具体 Pi 扩展设计。
discovery_backend: bounded discovery from LinkedIn ordinary public relevant-post surfaces
readback_backend: bounded ordinary guest-visible canonical LinkedIn public post in in-app browser
limitations: 插件效果和安全性为作者自述、未安装复现；确切日期不可见，保持 unknown。未登录、未互动。
readback_observation: Canonical guest page showed Vahid Kowsari and the complete body for Local BM25 RAG and Persistent Terminal, including keyword retrieval and preservation of cwd, virtualenv and environment variables versus a fresh bash subshell; only relative 4mo was visible.
